pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: hybrid-search-fusion covers fusing lexical with vector channels; it presumes BM25 rather than explaining it — complementary, not duplicate.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: The standard lexical ranking function for four decades — probabilistic relevance framework, explicit formula, named parameters (k1, b), stable variants (BM25F).

actionability.rationale: The scoring function is given in full and is directly implementable; it is the exact function our retrieval design names as the seed stage.
